item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"For a `dspy.Reasoning` output field, DSPy resolves `reasoning_effort` from `lm_kwargs` first, then `lm.kwargs`, and defaults it to `'low'` if neither provides a value.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"DSPy does not enable native reasoning if the resolved `reasoning_effort` is `None` or if `lm.supports_reasoning` is false; in those cases it returns the original signature unchanged.","span_ids":["s2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"DSPy also deliberately skips native reasoning for chat models whose `lm.model` contains `gpt-5`, even when a `Reasoning` field is present.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"When native reasoning is enabled, DSPy writes the chosen `reasoning_effort` into `lm_kwargs` and removes the reasoning field from the signature.","span_ids":["s4"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"After using the native path, DSPy reconstructs reasoning from `reasoning_content` in the LM response, and streamed chunks read `choices[0].delta.reasoning_content` when available.","span_ids":["s5","s6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":53,"end_line":61},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":63,"end_line":67},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":68,"end_line":73},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":75,"end_line":77},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":80,"end_line":84},{"span_id":"s6","path":"dspy/adapters/types/reasoning.py","start_line":97,"end_line":101}]}
